content:
# Crossplane XRD + Composition: Versioned Bucket with RDS & IAM

Below is a production-ready implementation using Crossplane's **function-patch-and-transform** composition mode to provision S3 (versioned + encrypted), RDS PostgreSQL (deletion protection), and IAM role, with dev/prod environment isolation.

---

## 1. CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD)

```yaml
# xrd-versioned-bucket.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xversionedbuckets.spine.io
spec:
  group: spine.io
  names:
    kind: XVersionedBucket
    plural: xversionedbuckets
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedBucket
    plural: versionedbuckets
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              parameters:
                type: object
                properties:
                  environment:
                    type: string
                    enum: [dev, prod]
                    description: "Deployment environment"
                  region:
                    type: string
                    default: "us-east-1"
                    description: "AWS region"
                  bucketName:
                    type: string
                    description: "S3 bucket name (must be globally unique)"
                  enableReplication:
                    type: boolean
                    default: false
                    description: "Enable cross-region replication (prod: us-west-2)"
                  rdsInstanceClass:
                    type: string
                    enum: [db.t3.micro, db.t3.medium]
                    default: db.t3.micro
                    description: "RDS instance type (dev: micro, prod: medium)"
                  dbName:
                    type: string
                    description: "Database name"
                  masterUsername:
                    type: string
                    description: "RDS master username"
                  roleName:
                    type: string
                    description: "IAM role name for service account"
                  providerConfigName:
                    type: string
                    default: "aws-default"
                    description: "ProviderConfig reference name"
                required:
                  - environment
                  - bucketName
                  - dbName
                  - masterUsername
                  - roleName
            required:
              - parameters
          status:
            type: object
            properties:
              bucketArn:
                type: string
              bucketRegionalDomainName:
                type: string
              rdsEndpoint:
                type: string
              rdsArn:
                type: string
              iamRoleArn:
                type: string
```

---

## 2. Composition (function-patch-and-transform)

```yaml
# composition-versioned-bucket.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versioned-bucket-composition-pnt
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: spine.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XVersionedBucket
  mode: Resources  # Traditional patch-and-transform; replaces PatchAndTransform in v1.14+
  
  resources:
  
  # ============================================================================
  # Resource 1: S3 Bucket with Versioning & Encryption
  # ============================================================================
  - name: s3-bucket
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      metadata:
        name: placeholder
      spec:
        forProvider:
          region: us-east-1
          acl: private
        providerConfigRef:
          name: aws-default
    patches:
    # Set bucket name from composite
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    
    # Set region
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
    
    # Set provider config reference
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
      toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
    
    # Propagate status back to composite
    - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
      toFieldPath: status.bucketArn
    - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.regionalDomainName
      toFieldPath: status.bucketRegionalDomainName
  
  # Versioning Configuration
  - name: s3-bucket-versioning
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: BucketVersioning
      metadata:
        name: placeholder-versioning
      spec:
        forProvider:
          bucket: placeholder
          region: us-east-1
          versioningConfiguration:
          - status: Enabled
        providerConfigRef:
          name: aws-default
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-versioning"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
      toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
  
  # Server-Side Encryption Configuration
  - name: s3-bucket-encryption
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
      metadata:
        name: placeholder-sse
      spec:
        forProvider:
          bucket: placeholder
          region: us-east-1
          rule:
          - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
            - sseAlgorithm: AES256
        providerConfigRef:
          name: aws-default
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-sse"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
      toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
  
  # Public Access Block Configuration
  - name: s3-bucket-public-access-block
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
      metadata:
        name: placeholder-pab
      spec:
        forProvider:
          bucket: placeholder
          region: us-east-1
          blockPublicAcls: true
          blockPublicPolicy: true
          ignorePublicAcls: true
          restrictPublicBuckets: true
        providerConfigRef:
          name: aws-default
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-pab"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
      toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
  
  # Cross-Region Replication (conditional on enableReplication)
  - name: s3-bucket-replication
    base:
      apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: BucketReplicationConfiguration
      metadata:
        name: placeholder-replication
      spec:
        forProvider:
          bucket: placeholder
          region: us-east-1
          role: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/s3-replication-role
          rule:
          - id: replicateAll
            status: Enabled
            destination:
            - bucket: arn:aws:s3:::replica-bucket-placeholder
              replicationTime:
              - status: Enabled
                time:
                - minutes: 15
        providerConfigRef:
          name: aws-default
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-replication"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
      toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
    # Only include in prod
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
      toFieldPath: metadata.labels[environment]
  
  # ============================================================================
  # Resource 2: RDS PostgreSQL Instance with Deletion Protection
  # ============================================================================
  - name: rds-instance
    base:
      apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Instance
      metadata:
        name: placeholder-rds
      spec:
        forProvider:
          region: us-east-1
          engine: postgres
          engineVersion: "14"
          instanceClass: db.t3.micro
          allocatedStorage: "20"
          storageType: gp3
          storageEncrypted: true
          skipFinalSnapshot: false
          copyTagsToSnapshot: true
          backupRetentionPeriod: 7
          backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
          maintenanceWindow: "sun:04:00-sun:05:00"
          multiAZ: false
          publiclyAccessible: false
          deletionProtection: false
          enableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: true
          enableCloudwatchLogsExports:
          - postgresql
        providerConfigRef:
          name: aws-default
    patches:
    # Identifiers and naming
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-rds"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
    
    # Credentials (reference external secret)
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.masterUsername
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.masterUsername
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.masterUsername
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.masterUserPassword.secretKeyRef.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-db-password"
    
    # Region and provider
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
      toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
    
    # Environment-specific: instance class
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsInstanceClass
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
    
    # Environment-specific: Multi-AZ (dev: false, prod: true)
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ
      transforms:
      - type: map
        map:
          dev: false
          prod: true
    
    # Environment-specific: Deletion Protection (dev: false, prod: true)
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.deletionProtection
      transforms:
      - type: map
        map:
          dev: false
          prod: true
    
    # Environment-specific: Backup retention (dev: 7, prod: 30)
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
      transforms:
      - type: map
        map:
          dev: 7
          prod: 30
    
    # Propagate status
    - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
      toFieldPath: status.rdsEndpoint
    - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
      toFieldPath: status.rdsArn
  
  # ============================================================================
  # Resource 3: IAM Role for Service Account (OIDC Trust)
  # ============================================================================
  - name: iam-role
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Role
      metadata:
        name: placeholder-sa-role
      spec:
        forProvider:
          # Placeholder OIDC trust policy; production should reference actual OIDC provider
          assumeRolePolicy: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Principal": {
                    "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLEOIDCID"
                  },
                  "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                  "Condition": {
                    "StringEquals": {
                      "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLEOIDCID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:app-sa"
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          tags:
            Environment: dev
        providerConfigRef:
          name: aws-default
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.roleName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.roleName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.name
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags[Environment]
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
      toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
    - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
      toFieldPath: status.iamRoleArn
  
  # IAM Policy: Least-Privilege S3 + RDS + Secrets Manager access
  - name: iam-policy
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Policy
      metadata:
        name: placeholder-app-policy
      spec:
        forProvider:
          policy: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Sid": "S3BucketAccess",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "s3:GetObject",
                    "s3:PutObject",
                    "s3:DeleteObject",
                    "s3:ListBucket",
                    "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                  ],
                  "Resource": [
                    "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME",
                    "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME/*"
                  ]
                },
                {
                  "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "rds-db:connect"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:db:DB_RESOURCE_ID"
                },
                {
                  "Sid": "SecretsManagerRead",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"
                  ],
                  "Resource": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:secret:DB_PASSWORD*"
                }
              ]
            }
        providerConfigRef:
          name: aws-default
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.roleName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-policy"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: |
            {
              "Version": "2012-10-17",
              "Statement": [
                {
                  "Sid": "S3BucketAccess",
                  "Effect": "Allow",
                  "Action": [
                    "s3:GetObject",
                    "s3:PutObject",
                    "s3:DeleteObject",
                    "s3:ListBucket",
                    "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                  ],
                  "Resource": [
                    "arn:aws:s3:::%s",
                    "arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"
                  ]
                }
              ]
            }
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
      toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
  
  # Attach Policy to Role
  - name: iam-role-policy-attachment
    base:
      apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: RolePolicyAttachment
      metadata:
        name: placeholder-attach
      spec:
        forProvider:
          policyArn: ""
          roleRef:
            name: placeholder-sa-role
        providerConfigRef:
          name: aws-default
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.roleName
      toFieldPath: metadata.name
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "%s-attach"
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.roleName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleRef.name
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
      toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
    # Dynamically construct policy ARN from policy name
    - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
      fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.roleName
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policyArn
      transforms:
      - type: string
        string:
          fmt: "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:policy/%s-policy"
```

---

## 3. Usage: Dev & Prod Claims

### Dev Environment Claim

```yaml
# claim-dev.yaml
apiVersion: spine.io/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucket
metadata:
  name: app-bucket-dev
  namespace: default
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: myapp-assets-dev-us-east-1
    enableReplication: false
    rdsInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
    dbName: appdb_dev
    masterUsername: postgres
    roleName: myapp-sa-role-dev
    providerConfigName: aws-dev
```

### Prod Environment Claim

```yaml
# claim-prod.yaml
apiVersion: spine.io/v1alpha1
kind: VersionedBucket
metadata:
  name: app-bucket-prod
  namespace: default
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: myapp-assets-prod-us-east-1
    enableReplication: true
    rdsInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
    dbName: appdb_prod
    masterUsername: postgres
    roleName: myapp-sa-role-prod
    providerConfigName: aws-prod
```

---

## 4. Key Design Decisions

| Requirement | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **S3 Versioning** | Separate `BucketVersioning` resource, always `Enabled` |
| **Encryption** | `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` with AES-256 (KMS via parameter extension) |
| **RDS Deletion Protection** | Conditional patch: `false` (dev), `true` (prod) |
| **RDS Multi-AZ** | Conditional: `false` (dev/micro), `true` (prod/medium) |
| **RDS Backup Retention** | Conditional: `7` days (dev), `30` days (prod) |
| **IAM OIDC Trust** | Base role with placeholder; inject real OIDC ID via external secret or controller logic |
| **Least Privilege** | S3 (GetObject, PutObject, ListBucket, versioning), RDS (rds-db:connect), Secrets Manager (GetSecretValue) |
| **Environment Isolation** | Separate Claims + ProviderConfig per region/environment; namespaced resources |
| **Public Access Block** | Always enabled; no exceptions |
| **Secret Management** | Database password referenced as external Secret (SOPS or Sealed Secrets in real deployment) |

---

## 5. Deployment Instructions

```bash
# Install Crossplane and AWS provider (if not already done)
helm repo add crossplane-stable https://charts.crossplane.io/stable
helm install crossplane crossplane-stable/crossplane --namespace crossplane-system --create-namespace

# Install AWS provider
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Provider
metadata:
  name: provider-aws
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/upbound/provider-aws:v1.0.0
EOF

# Wait for provider ready
kubectl wait --for=condition=Healthy provider/provider-aws --timeout=300s

# Apply XRD
kubectl apply -f xrd-versioned-bucket.yaml

# Apply Composition
kubectl apply -f composition-versioned-bucket.yaml

# Deploy dev claim
kubectl apply -f claim-dev.yaml

# Deploy prod claim
kubectl apply -f claim-prod.yaml

# Watch resource creation
kubectl get xversionedbuckets -w
kubectl get versioned-buckets -w
```

---

## 6. Verification

```bash
# Check composite resource status
kubectl describe versionedbucket app-bucket-dev

# List managed resources
kubectl get managed -l crossplane.io/composite=app-bucket-dev

# Verify RDS deletion protection
aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier appdb-prod \
  --query 'DBInstances[0].DeletionProtection'

# Verify S3 versioning
aws s3api get-bucket-versioning --bucket myapp-assets-prod-us-east-1

# Check IAM role trust policy
aws iam get-role --role-name myapp-sa-role-prod --query 'Role.AssumeRolePolicyDocument'
```

---

## 7. Notes on Production Hardening

- **Secret password storage**: Use Crossplane `SecretStore` + SOPS to encrypt RDS password before committing
- **OIDC provider ID**: Inject dynamically via controller patch or ExternalSecret controller
- **Replication bucket**: Pre-create or reference via additional composition resource
- **Monitoring**: Add CloudWatch alarms for RDS via composition extensions
- **Tagging**: Extend `tags` for cost allocation and compliance
- **Policy ARN construction**: Replace `ACCOUNT_ID` with dynamic reference (use external data source or observe pattern)

This composition is **idempotent**, **independently deployable** per environment, and follows **least-privilege** IAM principles.
